Proxy Manager help

Start-up usage:

Command to run: run_ue_proxy_mngr --ueproxy_ports_range XXX YYY
--ueproxy_ports_range : set range of port integer values for proxy packages
optional params:
-h, --help : show help message and exit
-p PORT, --port PORT : define port for proxy manager server (default: 443 or 80)
--ueproxy_ports_range UEPROXY_PORTS_RANGE UEPROXY_PORTS_RANGE : define port range for ueproxy to be started by proxy manager service (i.e. 8000 8100)
--ueproxy_config UEPROXY_CONFIG : config file for ueproxy to be started by proxy manager service(default: proxy.cfg), if you provide directory we will search proxy.cfg there.
--ssl_keyfile SSL_KEYFILE : file containing proxy manager server private key
--ssl_certfile SSL_CERTFILE : file containing proxy manager server certificate
--ssl_client_certbundle SSL_CLIENT_CERTBUNDLE : client root certificates for https dialog between UE-proxy manager and UE-proxy
--dev_https : use development time certificate (self-signed)
--update_period UPDATE_PERIOD : define time period for autoupdating ueproxy - format: 1h -> 1hour, 1d -> 1day, 1w -> 1week, 1m -> 1month
--update_plugin UPDATE_PLUGIN : define plugins for autoupdating ueproxy
--update_format UPDATE_FORMAT : define plugins for autoupdating ueproxy
--logs_storage_limit LOGS_STORAGE_LIMIT : number of maximum instances of logs that manager can store
--logs_storage_duration LOGS_STORAGE_DURATION : number of days for which logs will be stored

Web UI:

"Settings"
autoupdate : By default newly started manager has it set to True. When ON - on the test start tries to update proxy.access package to the latest.

"Proxy MNGR releases" : "Download new release packages" - package loading section
Proxy version : Desired taf.ue.proxy version, eg. 1.18.0
UE type : Desired type of UE (lowercase), use "Known" buttons
Access version : Desired proxy.access version, eg. 1.3.0
Upload specific package : Load package from local storage (package must be named with right pattern, eg. ueproxy-1.18.0-py39-win-android-1.3.1.pyz)
"Proxy MNGR releases" : "Local release packages" - package inventory on proxy manager side
Start : Start package service
Remove : Remove package from local storage inventory

"Active proxies" : activated or deactivated from use services running on server side
Start : Start package service (if 'inactive')
Release : Make service inhibited from use (set 'inactive')
Stop : Stop package and remove from this list
Proxy Manager docs
Proxy Manager (taf.ue.proxy.mngr):
Short info:
MNGR server to administrate proxy packages. Place of use: UE_PC, where UEs are installed.
Link: taf.ue.proxy.mngr [DOCS]

Proxy Manager Client (taf.ue.proxy.mngr_client):
Short info:
Wrapper for taf.ue plugins (and ute_ue) to make available to work with proxy.mngr, when UE configuration have 'proxy_mngr_port' value set. Install the library on VM.
Link: taf.ue.proxy.mngr_client [DOCS]
